definitions.explanation: Sweets and desserts that originated in Western countries, as opposed to traditional Japanese sweets. Includes cakes, cookies, chocolate, etc.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{洋菓子|ようがし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: This shop is famous for Western sweets.

examples.japanese: {洋菓子|ようがし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{茶|ちゃ}→お茶：00576_ocha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{一緒|いっしょ}→一緒：02848_issho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いただく→いただく：01326_itadaku⟧。
examples.english: Have Western sweets together with tea.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{洋菓子|ようがし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}いました→買う：00489_kau⟧。
examples.english: I bought a Western-style cake for my birthday.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{洋菓子|ようがし}⟦{店|てん}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}→注文：03485_chuumon⟧⟦しました→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I ordered a birthday cake for my friend at the Western sweets shop in front of the station.

examples.english: Japanese Western sweets are beautiful and delicious, so they are appreciated as gifts.

notes:
{洋菓子|ようがし} refers to Western-style sweets and desserts.

⟦{洋|よう}→洋：28890_you⟧ = Western, ⟦{菓子|かし}→菓子：00191_kashi⟧ = sweets/confectionery

Common types:
- ⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧ (cake)
- ⟦クッキー→クッキー：10798_kukkii⟧ (cookies)
- ⟦チョコレート→チョコレート：05183_chokoreeto⟧ (chocolate)
- ⟦シュークリーム→シュークリーム：noentry⟧ (cream puff)
- ⟦タルト→タルト：27311_taruto⟧ (tart)
- ⟦マカロン→マカロン：30401_makaron⟧ (macaron)
- ⟦プリン→プリン：11123_purin⟧ (pudding/crème caramel)

Characteristics:
- Uses dairy (butter, cream, milk)
- Often uses wheat flour
- Typically sweeter than Japanese sweets
- Paired with coffee or tea

Opposite: ⟦{和菓子|わがし}→和菓子：04962_wagashi⟧ (Japanese sweets)
- Uses ⟦{餡子|あんこ}→餡子：08654_anko⟧, rice flour, etc.
- Less dairy, more natural flavors
- Paired with green tea
